entries.notes: All nine TypeScript declarations are expanded into 16 executable Rust cases. Coverage preserves exact 1-based attempt advancement for zero, one, and Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER - 1; the shared RangeError contract for negative, fractional, maximum, above-maximum, NaN, and infinite inputs; null/empty logs; step/event filtering; owner-scoped counts; totalAttempts as bare starts plus the largest single owner; the workflow#3069 racer regression; real repeated-owner timeout ceilings; and mixed owned-to-bare retry ceilings. Security and availability behavior requires exact safe-integer accounting and prevents racing one-off owner stamps from falsely exhausting a healthy step's retry budget while still bounding genuine retries. Final GREEN must share the production Rust event model and executor retry counter, preserve owner-message identity, and avoid lossy floating-point or saturating arithmetic.
